method: naive single-prompt (full schema, no retrieval, no validator), temp 0.1, exec-accuracy vs gold on eval_store.sqlite — same model/temp as the DBWhisper pipeline

rows.q: How many customers are there?
rows.gen_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers

rows.q: How many orders have the status 'shipped'?
rows.gen_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'shipped'

rows.q: List all the distinct product categories.
rows.gen_sql: SELECT DISTINCT category FROM products

rows.q: What is the average price of a product?
rows.gen_sql: SELECT AVG(price) FROM products

rows.q: List the names of customers who live in Mumbai.
rows.gen_sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE city = 'Mumbai'

rows.q: What is the total revenue across all order items?
rows.gen_sql: SELECT SUM(order_items.quantity * products.price) FROM order_items JOIN products ON order_items.product_id = products.id

rows.q: How many products are in the Electronics category?
rows.gen_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE category = 'Electronics'

rows.q: Which city has the most customers?
rows.gen_sql: SELECT city FROM customers GROUP BY city ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

rows.q: What is the name of the most expensive product?
rows.gen_sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE price = (SELECT MAX(price) FROM products) LIMIT 1

rows.q: How many orders did the customer named 'Aisha Khan' place?
rows.gen_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE customer_id = (SELECT id FROM customers WHERE name = 'Aisha Khan')

rows.q: List the product names in the Furniture category.
rows.gen_sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE category = 'Furniture'

rows.q: How many orders were cancelled?
rows.gen_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled'

rows.q: What is the total quantity of items ordered across all order items?
rows.gen_sql: SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM order_items

rows.q: How many distinct customers have placed at least one order?
rows.gen_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM orders

rows.q: How many products cost more than 1000?
rows.gen_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE price > 1000

rows.q: List the names of customers who signed up in March 2025.
rows.gen_sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', signup_date) = '2025-03'

rows.q: How many orders are there in total?
rows.gen_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders

rows.q: List the three most expensive products by name.
rows.gen_sql: SELECT name FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 3

rows.q: How many customers are from Delhi or Bengaluru?
rows.gen_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE city IN ('Delhi', 'Bengaluru')

rows.q: What is the price of the product named 'Office Chair'?
rows.gen_sql: SELECT price FROM products WHERE name = 'Office Chair'

rows.q: How many order items reference the product 'Wireless Mouse'?
rows.gen_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items INNER JOIN products ON order_items.product_id = products.id WHERE products.name = 'Wireless Mouse'

rows.q: Which customer placed the most orders? Give the customer name.
rows.gen_sql: SELECT customers.name FROM customers JOIN orders ON customers.id = orders.customer_id GROUP BY customers.id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
